segments.text: Record hours across several stories in one step. Preview each share, then save the whole group.
Start on Noah's hours page. He has eight and a half hours logged across two stories.
Choose Log across stories, then select the work you want to include. Here, we'll select three stories.
Enter three hours. The preview divides that total equally, giving each story one hour.
Five hours becomes two, one and a half, and one and a half. The first story receives the remainder.
Add a note. The same date and note will appear on all three entries.
Save the group. Noah now has thirteen and a half hours logged, including three and a half on completed work.
The health summary received two hours, with the date and shared note.
The client decision received one and a half hours as a separate entry.
The completed checklist also received one and a half hours.
Reload the page. The entries and totals are still here, confirming that the group was saved.
Filter to completed work to see the finished story. The overall totals stay visible.
One total, three stories. Five hours recorded together, with every quarter hour accounted for.
